topics.title: Anthropic launches its IPO roadshow at $70 to $78 a share
topics.summary: Anthropic began its investor roadshow on November 10, 2026, offering 825 million Class A shares at $70 to $78 each, with pricing expected on November 18 and a Nasdaq listing under ANT. Seven suppliers plan a $26 billion private placement alongside the offering.

topics.title: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon generally available to paying developers
topics.summary: Google moved Gemini 4 Carbon from restricted access to general availability in the paid Gemini API on November 10, 2026, at an introductory $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through November 30, and previewed a swarm feature for agents.

topics.title: DeepMind agents formally verify core Signal protocol code
topics.summary: Google DeepMind says its AlphaProof Code agents proved security properties of Signal's libsignal at machine-code level, covering the post-quantum handshake and Triple Ratchet for one-to-one chats. Group messaging and the full apps are out of scope. Proof artifacts are public.
